field_principles.inference_substrate: substrate honesty; board-touching measurements are hardware_smoke

field_principles.kv260_status: terminal board; reachability is SSH-only and must never be inferred from host removable storage, and a smoke is not a speedup claim
field_principles.new_diagnostic_angles_tried_this_milesto: prior milestones exhausted USB/permissions/tool-version/clock-rate/topology angles; this milestone must add genuinely new ones (debug-level raw TDO capture, probe firmware revision) so we do not re-burn a milestone
field_principles.polarfire_status: PolarFire has no terminal-state mandate; a reachable hash-verified smoke does not close the end-to-end-dispatch bar, so polarfire_workload_validated stays false until an operator confirms a full dispatch run
field_principles.preconditions_checked: fabrication guard; every board resource is checked before any workload
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: content hash catches silent artifact drift

gatemate_eliminated_causes.evidence: DirtyJTAG (1209:c0ca) enumerates via openFPGALoader --scan-usb and the probe opens
USB node group-accessible (root:uucp) and user is in the uucp group
openFPGALoader v1.1.1 matches the 2026-05-23 known-good baseline
DirtyJTAG probe bcdDevice=0x0111 (v1.11) unchanged from the May-2026 baseline; the PROBE firmware (distinct from the openFPGALoader tool version) is not a regression
100 kHz..15 MHz JTAG clock sweep (incl. the documented-working 15 MHz GM1Ax rate) all read 0 devices

new_diagnostic_angles_tried_this_milesto.actionable_next_step: operator: an all-ones raw TDO means the target is not driving JTAG -- reseat or replace the JTAG connection and confirm the GateMate board power LED, then re-run --detect --verbose-level 2 and check whether the raw word changes from 0xffffffff
new_diagnostic_angles_tried_this_milesto.finding: raw TDO readback 0xffffffff -- an all-ones/all-zeros IDLE word. No target TAP is driving TDO, so the JTAG scan chain reads the pulled idle level. This is the electrical signature of an OPEN / undriven JTAG connection or an unpowered board (physical layer), NOT a TAP present-but-answering-wrong.

new_diagnostic_angles_tried_this_milesto.actionable_next_step: none required: probe firmware is unchanged; it is not the cause and does not need reflashing
new_diagnostic_angles_tried_this_milesto.finding: DirtyJTAG probe bcdDevice=0111 (v1.11), product=DirtyJTAG -- unchanged from the May-2026 known-good baseline. The PROBE firmware is distinct from the openFPGALoader TOOL version already eliminated in v476, so a probe firmware regression is ruled out.

new_diagnostic_angles_tried_this_milesto.actionable_next_step: operator: reseat JTAG connection + verify board power, then re-run openFPGALoader -c dirtyJtag --detect --verbose-level 2
new_diagnostic_angles_tried_this_milesto.finding: requires_physical_access: the floating-TDO evidence points at the JTAG-side connection or board power. Reseat the JTAG ribbon/header between the DirtyJTAG probe and the GM1Ax, try a different JTAG cable and USB port, and confirm the GateMate power LED. USB enumerates, so the USB cable is NOT the suspect.
